core_categories: Complex Rehabilitation Technology; Mobility Equipment; Seating and Positioning Systems; Home Accessibility Solutions; Vehicle Modifications; Medical Supplies
specialty_focus: National Seating & Mobility is a specialty distributor and manufacturer of complex rehabilitation technology (CRT) and mobility equipment, focusing on custom wheelchairs and seating for individuals with complex physical disabilities. It provides clinical assessments, fitting, home accessibility solutions, and vehicle modifications, and also distributes wearable medical devices such as the Ekso Indego Personal Exoskeleton and the WHILL Model M power wheelchair.
key_brands: Matia Mobility, Ekso Bionics, WHILL, Permobil, Quantum Rehab, Invacare, Bruno, EZ Access, National Ramp, Prairie View, LUCI, others
